description: A giant bright green toad squats low on brown earth, facing the viewer head-on at eye level, its wide mouth stretched across the picture and its bulging dark eyes on top of its head. Its back and sides are lumpy, with darker green blotches and small orange-tipped warts; heavy front legs splay out to each side. Its pale belly and throat hang low, ridged with dark lines. The background is a flat light grey sky above a band of muddy brown ground. The mood is still and slightly comic yet menacing. Frame 1: the toad sits with its throat at rest. Frame 2: its throat and belly swell outward slightly. Frame 3: the throat stays puffed and then begins to settle. The resting pose is held long, the swell flashes briefly and the puffed pose lingers a moment, so the loop reads as a slow croaking breath.
title: Giant toad squatting on mud
